notes: Site authors no semantic CSS custom properties — the palette lives in Tailwind utility classes, so the hexes are exact, not sampled (beige #f0ece0, black #353839 — a charcoal, never #000, off-white #fffdf9, beige-dark #c4bfaf; beige-medium/light are the same #c4bfaf at 50%/30% alpha). The only authored vars are layout metrics: --header-height 67px, --header-mobile-bottom-bar-height 70px, --announcement-bar-height 80px, --container-padding clamp(1.25rem,3vw,2.5rem). `accent` is nominal: #e1a894 (10 occurrences, the recipe sticker chip) is the closest thing to an accent; per-café hues (#b52b2a, #006642, orange, teal) appear ~4 times each and rank nothing. `color.dark` omitted — craft.theme.supportsDark is false and the profile's `dark` payload is just the light palette echoed back; the dark bands are a device, not a theme. Type scale normalized from px (10/12/13/14/15/16/18/20/21/30/32/40/42/45); 40/42/45 collapsed to one display tier. Tracking recorded as em (raw px-per-size: 32px→3.2px, 30px→6px, 15px→3.75px, 12px→3px, 21px→0.42px) — note it *widens* with size, inverting the usual ramp. Line-heights collapsed from 14 raw values; 24px/16px (1775 hits) is body sans at 1.5. Radius: raw 11px and 50px are third-party (cookie widget, Swiper) and dropped. Only two real box-shadows exist on the page — the 32px/68px one belongs to a modal. Durations from `transition` frequency: 150ms hover (238 rules), 300ms state (131), 500-1000ms hero only. reduced_motion is 'respected' by the probe, but the single @media block holds only Tailwind's opt-in motion-reduce utilities, not a blanket disable.
